directorySources.name: LightningExchanges
directorySources.role: Primary structured seed for exchanges claiming Lightning deposits and withdrawals.
directorySources.limitations: Community-maintained; many proof links are old announcements and each candidate requires current first-party verification.

directorySources.name: Exchanges-With-LN
directorySources.role: Broad discovery list covering exchanges, brokers, wallets, P2P markets, and swaps.
directorySources.limitations: Stale and over-inclusive; listing does not by itself prove arbitrary external BOLT11 withdrawal.

directorySources.name: OpenReceive provider data v4
directorySources.role: Current structured discovery data with provider tutorials and capability hints.
directorySources.limitations: Discovery and corroboration only; every visible record still needs direct first-party evidence.

directorySources.name: Jameson Lopp Lightning resources
directorySources.role: Maintained ecosystem meta-directory and dead-link cross-check.
directorySources.limitations: Delegates exchange details to community lists and is not a provider capability matrix.

directorySources.name: Lightspark news and customer announcements
directorySources.role: Discovers newer exchange and financial-app Lightning integrations omitted by older directories.
directorySources.limitations: Vendor partnerships, UMA, merchant receipt, and arbitrary consumer BOLT11 withdrawal are not equivalent.

providers.name: Alby
